arrangement.description: Opening SATB, followed by unison melody with four-row organ accompaniment, then full SATB reprise.

unisonMelody.note: This is the separate printed unison line; the four organ rows contain an additional top part that duplicates it. The app displays four rows only.

notationConventions.verticalStroke: A printed | within the JSON separates two rhythmic half-bar groups in an inferred 4/4 measure; double bars are stored as metadata.
notationConventions.dash: Dash extends the preceding pitch, including across an entry boundary.
notationConventions.dot: Dot within a sol-fa cell subdivides it into two shorter note positions.
notationConventions.octaveMarks: Apostrophe raises one octave; subscript ₁ lowers one octave.
notationConventions.organChords: Additional organ tones in stacked brackets are stored in organChordAdditionalTone metadata.

reviewNotes: Written sol-fa has been visually transcribed from the scan but requires human musical proofreading.
4/4 is editorial; durations and rhythmic cells should be verified from the source notation conventions.
Unison passage includes four organ voices beyond the unison melody. The app displays a four-row reduction and stores three additional chord tones in organChordAdditionalTone.
The organ chord supplementary tones are included in the MIDI preview, but the current 4-voice React renderer may not play them automatically.
Some lyrics aligned under measure groups are normalized approximations; the complete four verses are transcribed separately.

transcriptionStatus: Provisional manual transcription; rhythm and organ reduction require verification.
